text:
Maya: Quick sync — we need final changelog bullet points + docs URLs for the release announcement. Launch targeted Wed 10:00am PT. Can eng confirm changelog + any gating constraints? Also need the benchmark talking points for the blog and webinar.

Sam: We're green on feature flags. Canary scheduled Tue 09:00am PT -> full rollout Wed 08:30am PT if no regressions. Draft changelog below, will refine.

Sam: Changelog draft:
- Streaming responses + function/tool calling: GA (includes streaming tokens and function arg hints).
- Dedicated capacity: configurable burst capacity + SLA notes for reserved pools.
- Redwood Optimize: new batching/caching heuristics and quant recommendations.

Sam: Example snippet for the docs: ```python
resp = client.generate(model='redwood-rt-1', prompt='Translate...')
for chunk in resp.stream():
    print(chunk.text)
```

Ellie: Docs: pushing a docs bundle to staging now. Staging link: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/release/v2/ . Final public permalink will be https://docs.redwood.ai/release/v2 after merge/publish. ETA to publish: Tue 6:00pm PT (post eng sign-off).

Raj: Bench numbers to use (conservative): 95th-tail latency down ~18% at seq=512 on A100; average tokens/sec up ~22% with KV caching. I'll attach perf table to the PR and leave a short paragraph you can quote: "~18% lower tail latency and ~22% higher throughput on typical chat workloads with caching enabled."

Jordan: Webinar + GTM notes — webinar Thu 11:00am PT, promo goes Wed morning. Need landing page + short copy + SDR routing ready at publish. Also confirm embargo window.

Sam: Embargo proposal: internal & press embargo until Wed 09:00am PT; public announcement Wed 10:00am PT. For lead routing: webhook fires immediately on publish to /integrations/marketing/leads — ops needs final docs URL and UTM params.

Ellie: Docs URL for routing (will redirect once live): https://docs.redwood.ai/release/v2 . I'll append UTM params per Jordan's req.

Maya: Perfect. Can someone paste final PR links and any regional caveats so comms can schedule posts and update the press kit?

Sam: Final changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/7421 — merge scheduled Tue 5:45pm PT. Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1189. Note: EU regional deploy will finish Wed ~11:00am PT, so avoid EU-first canary routing until ~13:00 PT.

Ellie: Merged docs -> will be live at https://docs.redwood.ai/release/v2 once the docs PR merges and the CDN invalidation runs. I'll ping here when live.

deploy-bot: canary:start cluster-alpha Tue 09:00 PT
deploy-bot: canary:health OK Tue 09:30 PT :rocket:

Raj: Perf artifacts uploaded to the PR. Small caveat: an int8 quant variant shows ~5% higher latency on very long sequences — we'll call that out under "notes and limits" in the release notes.

Maya: Thanks everyone — marketing will schedule social + blog for Wed 10:00am PT once PRs are merged and docs link is confirmed. Jordan — can you confirm landing page + SDR routing by Tue EOD so we can set automation?

Jordan: Confirmed. Landing page draft: https://marketing.redwood.ai/launch/v2-draft — SDR routing tests passed. I'll hand off final UTM list after Ellie posts the live docs URL.

Sam: LGTM on the copy, leaving a few comments in the PR. I'll be on standby during the Wed window for rollback/observability. :thumbsup:
